errors.text_span: През 2020 г. линията остава в диапазона между 5,5% и 6,5%
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect for the entire period of 2020 shown. The line starts at 4% in March, rises to 6.5% in May, and drops to 3.5% in June. The specified range only applies to the second half of 2020.

errors.text_span: достига върх с около 7,2% през март
errors.evidence: The peak in early 2021, which is just over 7%, occurs in April (month 4), not March (month 3). The value in March is lower, around 6.7%.

errors.text_span: ряко спада до около 3% през май
errors.evidence: The sharp drop does not occur in May. In May 2021 (month 5), the value is still high at approximately 6.5%. The drop happens after May, reaching about 3% in June 2021 (month 6).

errors.text_span: От юни 2021 г. до юни 2022 г. линията остава в диапазон между 2% и 3%
errors.evidence: The statement is an over-generalization. In November 2021 (month 11), the line peaks at a value slightly above 3% (approx. 3.2%).

errors.text_span: завършва при стойност около 1,8% през юни 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The final value in June 2022 is visibly closer to 1.5%, halfway between the 1% and 2% gridlines. 1.8% is an overestimation.
